CustomField.description: Picklist (Delete, Remove, Clear) supplying the Delete action's button text for Repeater and Table sections. Passed as delete-button-label to c-flow-form-repeat / c-flow-data-table. Only takes effect when Enable Delete Action is checked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose the wording for the delete-row button, such as Delete, Remove, or Clear. Requires Enable Delete Action to be on.
CustomField.label: Delete Button Label
